sourceEvidence.strandReconstruction: Recovered absorption, R/TT/TRT longitudinal offsets/widths, IOR and precomputed-light colorization; spatial strand-density and light-path atlases reconstruct DSVolume self-occlusion. Source dual-direction IBL restores local/propagated backscatter, angular lobes and variance terms. Source A/B/C gradients use authored arc/random bytes, original texels, cumulative selection and linear-RGB HSV operations; the endpoint weighted means remain a comparison fallback. Native64x64x16 DSLUT retains half storage and dynamic roughness-neighbor sampling; CPU generation follows the shipped estimator without claiming native-GPU bit identity. Separate premultiplied hair color/coverage history uses last-executed per-fiber motion.
limitations: Source profile selection and runtime scene overrides are not captured.
Screen-space skin diffusion preserves specular, depth and material boundaries; out-of-screen transport and original pass equivalence are not established.
Eye raster POM uses the recovered shader; original light tracing/caustic passes and scene-dependent reflection illumination are not executed.
Eye-shell UV masks/depth eligibility/blur follow source shaders; runtime projection/depth units and scene-normal/area-light reflection inputs remain adapted.
Full source DSVolume density/mip/scene-depth transport remain reconstruction limits; the host volume computes actual strand self-occlusion.

Hair source IBL uses a host SH environment by default; the optional ST30_101 study supplies extracted HDR and a six-axis source-formula adapter. Original spatial probe selection, runtime gains and third-chapter location remain unverified. Optional point IBL queries actual shading positions and directions; the default voxel-mean paths and the point mode both use the host density reconstruction, without native 3D mips/jitter. Legacy ambient and forward-only af^N modes remain comparison controls; source hair colors are unchanged.
View-dependent cloth sheen/cavity and animated wrinkles are not restored.
Hair source material ColorMap is disabled and TransColor_Rate is zero; the dynamic global BAB buffer was not captured and may override material color in the original runtime.

Area-preserving analytic ribbon filtering repairs a host coverage loss; native mixed hardware/Wu software rasterization, sorted OIT layers, depth coverage resolve and temporal filtering are not fully reproduced. Runtime LOD factor and active native temporal/MSAA state remain unobserved.

The full native DSLUT dimensions, sampling axes, half storage and CPU F0 writer are recovered; offline float32 quadrature may differ from native GPU fast-math/FMA. Material key changes fall back explicitly to the prior16x16 slice; no on-launch65536-texel CPU bake is performed.

eyeShading.normalPacking: slot5BA=sourceNormalRG,slot6A=sourceNormalB; all XYZ kept exactly, sampled independently from color UV

shadingRevision.transport: Raster direct light and precomputed environment; no RT/realtime GI.

hairAppearance.colorSpace: Original sRGB bytes decoded once before filtering; scene-linear float32 RGBA atlas

asset.payload: float32 RGBA; native half R/G exactly expanded, B=0 A=1; no flip or sRGB

consumer.sampling: normalized bilinear clamp, LOD 0, linear data
consumer.axes: X reverses incident tangent sine; Y is sqrt of azimuthal roughness
consumer.identityLimitations: Native embedded data and conversion recovered; original offline table generator remains unknown. The two separate embedded tables were compared byte-for-byte and are identical.

hairDslut.sampling: Texel-centered theta/roughness/absorption; eight-neighbor trilinear. Roughness clamps to [.18,.6].
hairDslut.f0Writer: Native CPU computes ((1-IOR)/(1+IOR))^2; direct/IBL single still use fixed1.5/.04.
hairDslut.fallback: Changing IOR, azimuthal roughness or cuticle tilt invalidates the immutable bake key and uses the legacy16x16 current-roughness slice.
